_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ssti#4. The rule holds — SSTI CONTROL/MONOLITHIC must name a LINEAR_SOLVER — but the failure is nothing like the memory-cost warning the entry gave. LINEAR_SOLVER defaults to -1 and is not validated, so on upstream ssti_mono_3D_3hex8_elch_s2i_butlervolmerthermo_growthlaw.4C.yaml deleting it makes 4C look for a section 'SOLVER -1' and die inside Teuchos: 'Teuchos::Exceptions::InvalidParameterName ... in the parameter (sub)list "ROOT->SOLVER -1".', SIGABRT, exit 134. There is no PROC 0 ERROR banner, no source file, the word LINEAR_SOLVER never appears, and SSTI is named only inside mangled backtrace symbols, never in a readable message — the defaulted -1 is the only clue. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep LINEAR_SOLVER in the second arm. The solver id resolves, the Teuchos exception vanishes and EXIT_NOSOLVER becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
